description: This PHP source file defines a class LoggerSubscriber that subscribes to Symfony Kernel's exception events and logs exception details using the framework's Logger utility.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony's Kernel exception events to log exception details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of event names and callback methods to which this subscriber listens.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by logging the exception message and trace.
